11// Compile-checked caller examples. Implementations of the ports are supplied by
12// the caller; these examples do not implement or simulate the Sattle engine.
13public static class UsageExamples
14{
15 #region composition
16 public static GraphSpaceDefinition Compose(
17 ProjectionDefinition ingestion, ProjectionDefinition services,
18 ProjectionDefinition business)
19 {
20 // services declares a "master" input; business declares "services"
21 // and "inventory" inputs. Their operators consume those exact names.
22 return new("1.0", "operations",
23 new MasterGraphDefinition(new GraphId("master"), ingestion),
24 [
25 new(new GraphId("services"), services,
26 [new("master", new MasterGraphSource(), ingestion.Ontology)]),
27 new(new GraphId("business"), business,
28 [new("services", new ProjectionGraphSource(services.Id), services.Ontology),
29 new("inventory", new MasterGraphSource(), ingestion.Ontology)])
30 ]);
31 // Each definition pins its own output ontology. The graph-space
32 // compiler still validates the named bindings, operators and types.
33 }
34 #endregion
35
36 #region subscription
37 public static async Task WatchGraphAsync(
38 IGraphSpace graphs, SubscribeGraph request,
39 Func<GraphFeedItem, CancellationToken, ValueTask> handle,
40 CancellationToken ct)
41 {
42 await foreach (var item in graphs.SubscribeAsync(One(request, ct), ct))
43 {
44 // The handler distinguishes snapshot pages, the ready seal,
45 // committed changes, progress and gaps. A gap requires recovery.
46 await handle(item, ct);
47 }
48 // Graph subscription reconnect/resume is still an open contract item.
49 }
50 #endregion
51
52 #region ingestion
53 public static async Task ConsumeInputsAsync(
54 IProjectionEngine engine, IAsyncEnumerable<EngineInput> input,
55 Func<IngestResult, CancellationToken, ValueTask> handleReceipt,
56 CancellationToken ct)
57 {
58 // input may yield NativeBatchInput with one record or many records.
59 // A file reader or event transport supplies the same async contract.
60 await foreach (var receipt in engine.IngestAsync(input, ct).WithCancellation(ct))
61 await handleReceipt(receipt, ct); // Handle acceptance AND rejection.
62 // Acceptance does not mean that every downstream projection committed.
63 // Observe committed graph changes through IGraphSpace.SubscribeAsync.
64 }
65 #endregion
66

68 public static IAsyncEnumerable<AdaptationResult> AdaptHubble(
69 IHubbleAdapter adapter, IAsyncEnumerable<NativeInput<HubbleMessage>> flows,
70 AdapterDefinition mapping, CancellationToken ct)
71 {
72 // The definition pins the supported native format and mapping version.
73 // Results can be observations, withdrawals, loss notices or rejections.
74 return adapter.AdaptAsync(flows, mapping, ct);

98 public static MatchOperator FindCalls() =>
99 new(new OperatorId("calls"), "master",
100 new GraphPattern(
101 [new("api", new TypeId("Service")),

118 public static IAsyncEnumerable<GraphSpaceCompilation> ValidateComposition(
119 IProjectionCompiler compiler, TenantId tenant, GraphSpaceDefinition space,
120 CancellationToken ct) =>
121 compiler.CompileGraphSpaceAsync(

127 #region union
128 public sealed record EndpointPair(EntityId Source, EntityId Target);
129
130 public static Rows<EndpointPair> CombinePairs(
131 Rows<EndpointPair> observed, Rows<EndpointPair> expected) =>
132 new UnionRows<EndpointPair>(observed, expected);
133 // Both inputs have already selected endpoints into the same row shape.
134 // This is an authoring expression. Lowering and semantic validation are
135 // still required; it does not execute a union or select a conflict policy.
136 #endregion

138 #region health
139 public static GroupOperator AnyFailedDependency() =>
140 new(new OperatorId("service-health"),
141 [new("service", new FieldExpression("service"))],
142 [new("degraded", AggregateFunction.Any,
143 new CallExpression(Function.Equal,
144 [new FieldExpression("dependencyHealth"),
145 new Literal(new TextValue("failed"))]))]);
146 // Upstream rows supply service and dependencyHealth. A downstream emitter
147 // maps the Boolean aggregate into a property declared by its output ontology.
148 #endregion

150 #region patches
151 public static PatchBatch PreserveEventBoundaries(GraphPatch first, GraphPatch next) =>
152 new([first, next]);
153
154 public static EvaluatePatch ComposePatches(GraphPatch first, GraphPatch next) =>
155 new(new RequestId("compose"),
156 new PatchThen(new PatchLiteral(first), new PatchLiteral(next)));
157 // Composition requires first.To == next.From and compatible graph scope.
158 // The algebra validates before-states; construction alone does not apply edits.
159 #endregion

161 #region deltas
162 public static EvaluateDelta Subtract(SignedDelta left, SignedDelta right) =>
163 new(new RequestId("subtract"),
164 new DeltaSubtract(new DeltaLiteral(left), new DeltaLiteral(right)));
165
166 public static ConvertDeltaToPatch AtBase(
167 SignedDelta delta, GraphVersion basis, GraphVersion target, ChangeCause cause) =>
168 new(new RequestId("materialize"), new DeltaAtBase(delta, basis, cause), target);
169 // Matching tenant, projection and ontology are required. Applying a signed
170 // result also needs a base graph: negative fact counts can be rejected.
171 #endregion

173 #region bounded-read
174 public static ReadGraph Neighborhood(GraphVersion version, EntityId root) =>
175 new(new RequestId("neighborhood"), version,
176 new GraphScope([root], 2, [new TypeId("Calls")]),
177 new WorkBudget(MaximumFacts: 10_000, MaximumSteps: 100_000),
178 Continuation: null);
179 // Submit through IGraphSpace.ReadAsync for stored or virtual graphs.
180 // Inspect Complete, MoreAvailable, BudgetExhausted and Unavailable on each
181 // returned page. A page by itself does not imply a complete neighborhood.
182 #endregion
183
184 #region recursion
185 public static TraverseOperator BoundedDependencies() =>
186 new(new OperatorId("dependencies"), new TypeId("Calls"),
187 Direction.Outgoing, MinimumDepth: 1, MaximumDepth: 4);
188 // This is a bounded traversal. Unbounded fixed-point derivation instead uses
189 // FixpointOperator with a finite domain, fact/iteration budgets and a checked
190 // monotone body. A budget alone does not establish convergence.
191 #endregion

193 #region correspondence
194 public static Correspondence DeploymentCapability(EntityId deployment, EntityId capability) =>
195 new("deployment-to-capability",
196 [new EntityRef(deployment)], [new EntityRef(capability)], []);
197 // The source deployment and target capability keep distinct identities.
198 // This correspondence is one TGG ingredient; it is not a full grammar or
199 // evidence that a forward/backward rule pair satisfies the lens laws.
200 #endregion

202 #region lens
203 public static IAsyncEnumerable<LensResult> ProposeBackward(
204 IBidirectionalProjection lens, BackwardEdit edit, LensContext context,
205 CancellationToken ct) =>
206 lens.ProposeBackwardAsync(One(new LensRequest(edit, context), ct), ct);
207 // The edit names an explicitly bidirectional rule and source/view base
208 // revisions. A proposed source patch still needs validation and atomic commit.
209 // This call never writes to Kubernetes or another external source system.
210 #endregion

213 public static EditProjection ReplaceDefinition(
214 TenantId tenant, ProjectionDefinition replacement, string expectedVersion) =>
215 new(new RequestId("edit-projection"), tenant, replacement.Id,
216 expectedVersion, replacement);

218 // The engine owns replay of retained inputs and resulting graph commits.

221 #region document
222 public static async Task RenderMarkdownAsync(
223 IDocumentProjection projection, IDocumentRenderer renderer,
224 ProjectDocument request,
225 Func<RenderedDocument, CancellationToken, ValueTask> save,
226 Func<DocumentResult, CancellationToken, ValueTask> reportFailure,
227 CancellationToken ct)
228 {
229 await foreach (var result in projection.ProjectAsync(One(request, ct), ct))
230 {
231 if (result.Snapshot is not { } snapshot || !result.Errors.IsEmpty)
232 {
233 await reportFailure(result, ct);
234 continue;
235 }
236 var render = new RenderDocument(result.Request, snapshot,
237 DocumentFormat.Markdown, RendererVersion: "1");
238 await foreach (var output in renderer.RenderAsync(One(render, ct), ct))
239 await save(output, ct);
240 }
241 // Snapshot.Sources records the graph versions used. Inspect completeness:
242 // explicitly truncated documents remain distinguishable from complete ones.
243 }
244 #endregion
245
246 private static async IAsyncEnumerable<T> One<T>(T item,
247 [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken ct)
248 {
249 await Task.CompletedTask;
250 ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
251 yield return item;
252 }
253}
